result:
Unit 355 is finished: all five tasks are done and pushed, nothing was dropped, and the report is in `output.md` (commit `9d5322c5`). Step 3 still waits on your verdict at your own window size. Everything below was measured by tests on the headless host; nobody has looked at the actual screen.

**One decision needs you (report section 4, item 1).** The work instruction said Stop should be greyed out when nothing is transmitting. I didn't build that: Stop can be pressed at every moment. The send plan's step 1 says the abort "cannot be disabled, deferred, or made conditional", and an existing test guards that. Pressing Stop before the slot starts is also how a queued send gets cancelled, and nothing is transmitting at that point. If you want it greyed when idle, say "grey Stop out when nothing is keyed".

- **Stop is now in the status bar**, at its right end, on every tab. It is on the window at all 9 of unit 354's sizes, up from 8 of 9; it had been below the bottom edge at 1100 ├ù 780, the size Hamlet opens at. It reads *Stop* when idle and *Stop transmitting* while a send is queued or going out. What pressing it does is unchanged, and the tests for the stop and the send path pass unedited.
- **CQ has not moved.** At 1100 ├ù 780 it is still below the window (y 800 on a 780 px window).
- **A PSK31 station's words now stay after he stops.** His row fades, says *ended*, and stays until you press Clear, retune far enough to clear the list, or 500 newer rows push it off. On the four-signal test recording, all four rows kept their text (483 characters). A row that never decoded any text still disappears with its signal. A station who comes back within 16 Hz and 15 seconds continues his old row.
- **You can still answer an ended CQ row.** One click sends one Answer on his frequency and opens his card at *His turn*.
- **The tests no longer contact callook.info.** Tests now get an answer that refuses by default, and the two layout test setups supply *General* for KC3QIS directly. The instruction's line "no HTTP client is created under test" still isn't true: the POTA and SOTA feeds create their clients when the view model is built, even when switched off. Neither sends anything in those tests (section 4, item 2).
- **Your review sheet** (`docs/unit349-what-tim-looks-at.md`) now describes where Stop is, includes a table of its position at the nine sizes, and explains that PSK31 rows stay.

**Test results.**
- **Before any change:** the app tests on the carry-forward list passed 111 of 111; the engine tests passed 86 of 86.
- **At the end:** that app list, plus the new tests and the layout, license and decoded-list tests they touch, passed 170 of 170. The engine wasn't changed, so it wasn't re-run.
- **Two existing tests' expectations were updated** to match your ruling that rows stay: one now treats a station as gone when his row ends, and one checks the new fade line.
